provenance.note: Controlled through a Matter controller (e.g. matter.js server) per the bridge's controller-client design. Level Control CurrentLevel runs 1-254; the bridge normalises it to the canonical 0-100 % range. Colour-temperature and extended-colour lights add the Color Control cluster (0x0300) with model-specific ranges - intentionally not claimed here.

source: Matter Application Cluster Specification: OnOff cluster (0x0006, OnOff attribute) and Level Control cluster (0x0008, CurrentLevel attribute) - the mandatory clusters for the Dimmable Light device type.
